records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 11% to $155.9 million during the three months ended June 30, 2024 from $140.4 million during the three months ended June 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 67% of our revenue during each of the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, as compared to 63% and 64% in the same periods in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: Software license revenue represented 2% of our revenue during each of the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, as compared to 3% in the same periods in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: We used $63.1 million of the net proceeds from the 2029 Notes to pay the cost of the capped call transactions and used $75.0 million to repurchase 1,117,068 shares of our common stock concurrently with the pricing of the 2029 Notes, which was separately authorized by our board of directors.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. JUNE 30, 2024
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2024, cash flows from operating activities were $72.8 million, compared to $33.3 million for the same period in the prior year.
